from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonetaryFunds(BaseModel):
    """The monetary funds reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, e.g. '珠海格力电器股份有限公司'")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/code if available, e.g. '000651'")
    monetary_funds_end: float | None = Field(description="The end-of-period monetary funds balance amount")
    monetary_funds_begin: float | None = Field(description="The beginning-of-period monetary funds balance amount if available")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monetary_funds_records: list[MonetaryFunds]
